decisions.reason: The hierarchical search bundle is a cheap-to-maintain plugin for the established web map platform, but it has not appeared on the website since 2018, so its relevance may be fading.

VueTOC was an experimental mobile component that has not been visible since its 2018 launch and has likely been superseded by responsive features in the core platform, so the resources are better used for core development.
The GIS solution platform is the firm's flagship product line and strategic focus, so it will be kept.
Mobile field data capture remains a core need for utility and public-sector customers, even though its web presence has declined.
The search extension is closely tied to the established web map apps and is likely still used in customer projects, though it is less prominent than at launch.
